name: Jameson "Jay" Harding
bio:
Jay Harding is a performance engineer with a quarter-century of experience fine-tuning racing machines. Growing up near the Indianapolis Motor Speedway, he was hooked on motorsport from a young age, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts and dreaming of a career in racing. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Jay cut his teeth in IndyCar before transitioning to junior formula racing.

Known for his meticulous approach and calm demeanor under pressure, Jay is a master of data analysis and vehicle dynamics. He excels at identifying subtle areas for improvement and translating them into tangible performance gains. While he respects tradition, he's always eager to explore innovative solutions, making him a valuable asset to any team. He joined Prema Junior after a long and successful stint in IndyCar.

Jay's distinctive approach involves a blend of rigorous quantitative analysis and keen observation. He believes in fostering open communication between the driver and the engineering team, ensuring that everyone is working towards the same goal. He is known to have a sixth sense about car setup.

physical.description: A tall, lean man with a weathered face and piercing blue eyes.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out slide rule, despite using computer software.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of coffee before every race.
